issue_request: FHIR-12624 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for DSTU2. It asked DataRequirement to support referring to fields defined in extensions, using QI-Patient birthTime in mustSupport as the motivating example. Its resolution said the request was addressed by the FHIR-13593/GF#13593 mustSupport path clarification.
initial_application: FHIR-13593 was applied by git/SVN commit 74161b7e2037bc36b915e2d57d02743cc607ad3f, which made DataRequirement.mustSupport constrained FHIRPath and linked the Simple FHIRPath Profile. That preserved the application trail for FHIR-12624, but the current mustSupport definition still repeated the older local restriction to identifiers, constant indexers, and .resolve(), which conflicted with the current Simple FHIRPath Profile's .extension("url") support.
additional_context: The Zulip DataRequirement thread records the original birthTime extension-field question and the request to file GF#13593. A later implementers thread about DataRequirement paths says FHIRPath .extension() identifies specific extensions. The combined branch already contains a no-change audit for FHIR-13593, so this result does not re-decide that related issue; it fixes the seed-specific extension-field ambiguity in the current source.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/datarequirement.xml so DataRequirement.mustSupport conforms to the Simple FHIRPath Profile and explicitly notes that .extension("url") can identify extension elements. Changed source/fhirpath.html so DataRequirement.mustSupport appears in the restricted Simple FHIRPath location list.
